mutant.description: the selftest's negative arms: a closed port (case 2) must read CLOSED, a probe that cannot start (case 3) must read PROBE-ERROR, a differing hostname (case 4) must read MISMATCH, a password login that succeeds (case 5) must read LOGGED-IN, a password-advertising denial (case 7) must read ADVERTISED and not done; each must read not-done. Plus a direct call of password_verdict (outside the selftest): a denial with no parenthesised list reads PROBE-ERROR, a publickey-only list reads REFUSED, a publickey,password list reads ADVERTISED.
mutant.expected: CLOSED, PROBE-ERROR, MISMATCH:someone-else, LOGGED-IN, ADVERTISED:publickey,password, all done=False; direct call PROBE-ERROR / REFUSED / ADVERTISED:publickey,password
mutant.observed: selftest CLOSED, PROBE-ERROR (ssh missing and connect raising), MISMATCH:someone-else, LOGGED-IN, ADVERTISED:publickey,password, all done=False; direct call 'Permission denied, please try again.' -> PROBE-ERROR, 'Permission denied (publickey).' -> REFUSED, 'Permission denied (publickey,password).' -> ADVERTISED:publickey,password, 'Permission denied (publickey,keyboard-interactive).' -> ADVERTISED:publickey,keyboard-interactive, rc 0 with no output -> LOGGED-IN
